sloka: मृदुष्व् अन्गेषु कासाम्चित् कुच अग्रेषु च सम्स्थिताः ।बभूवुर् भूषणानि इव शुभा भूषण राजयः ॥५-९-५३॥
transliteration: mṛduṣv angeṣu kāsāmcit kuca agreṣu ca samsthitāḥ ।babhūvur bhūṣaṇāni iva śubhā bhūṣaṇa rājayaḥ ॥5-9-53॥

translations.english: The beautiful imprints made by the (heavy) ornaments on the tender limbs, breasts and nipples of some women appeared like many ornaments.
